public_payload.normalized_proposition: Most companies buying Nvidia chips were not making profits from them.

our_interpretation: Mostly means more than half of buyer companies by company count, rather than a majority of spending.
Profit means a positive result after the costs of activities using the chips, rather than revenue growth or company-wide profit alone.
The surrounding statement describes a continuing state. Use July–September 2026, the latest completed calendar quarter normally reportable before the post, as the common reporting window.
The AI context limits the population to buyers of Nvidia chips for AI. Marcus supplies no accounting basis.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable records covering a defined, representative population show that more than half of Nvidia AI-chip buyer companies did not earn profits from their chip-using activities during the target quarter.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records show that at least half of those buyer companies earned profits from their chip-using activities during the target quarter.
